checks.yes: Scenario grid and bundle metadata agree.
checks.no: Scenario grid or bundle identity differs from the loaded terrain.
checks.action: Reload the intended bundle and rebuild the scenario; do not relabel existing arrays.

checks.yes: A terrain provider and source records are present; accuracy and coverage remain unverified.
checks.no: Terrain provider or source records are missing.
checks.action: Obtain terrain provenance and verify spatial coverage, artefacts and local elevation accuracy.

checks.yes: Native terrain resolution is recorded. Simulation cell size does not establish elevation accuracy.
checks.no: Native terrain resolution is unknown; grid spacing is not a substitute.
checks.action: Check the terrain product's native resolution and whether channels, barriers and buildings are resolved.

checks.yes: Terrain acquisition epoch has not been verified for this scenario.
checks.no: Terrain acquisition epoch has not been verified for this scenario.
checks.action: Verify survey dates against the event or planning date. Download timestamps do not establish terrain age.

checks.yes: The computational extent has not been admitted as a complete hydraulic domain.
checks.no: The computational extent has not been admitted as a complete hydraulic domain.
checks.action: Review contributing catchment, open boundaries, connectivity and flow paths beyond the map square.

checks.yes: Rainfall timing and depth pass the scenario contract; event representativeness remains unverified.
checks.no: Rainfall timing and depth pass the scenario contract; event representativeness remains unverified.
checks.action: Supply event rainfall provenance and check spatial variability, antecedent wetness and local soil properties.

checks.yes: Terrain and water-level datum descriptions are present, but their transformation and uncertainty are unverified.
checks.no: Terrain datum is unresolved or its local elevation offset is missing.
checks.action: Verify a common vertical reference, epoch, units and offset using sourced transformation evidence. Matching labels alone are insufficient.

checks.yes: Configured coastal cells have valid times and indices; spatial forcing coverage remains unverified. Other edges remain closed.
checks.no: Configured coastal cells have valid times and indices; spatial forcing coverage remains unverified. Other edges remain closed.
checks.action: Audit every hydraulically open boundary against observed or modelled forcing; missing support must not be inferred from configured cell count.

checks.yes: The simulation holds the final coastal level after the supplied series ends.
checks.no: The coastal series spans the simulation window; observation provenance remains unverified.
checks.action: Confirm that the supplied hydrograph and any held tail represent the event and its recession.

checks.yes: Seabed elevations, channels and hydraulic structures have not been verified.
checks.no: Seabed elevations, channels and hydraulic structures have not been verified.
checks.action: Obtain and review bathymetry, channels and bridge/culvert geometry where they control coastal connectivity.

checks.yes: Prescribed inflow timing passes the contract; discharge provenance and spatial allocation remain unverified.
checks.no: Prescribed inflow timing passes the contract; discharge provenance and spatial allocation remain unverified.
checks.action: Verify the discharge hydrograph, contributing domain and inflow allocation. The current source imposes no momentum.

checks.yes: Parameterised outlets are present; sewer routing, surcharge and reverse flow are not represented.
checks.no: Parameterised outlets are present; sewer routing, surcharge and reverse flow are not represented.
checks.action: Verify outlet elevations, capacities and tailwater; use a validated network coupling when those processes matter.
